name.desc: Node display label shown on the canvas.

assetId.desc: Library asset bound to this node. Written by the upload pipeline.

mimeType.desc: MIME type of the bound asset.

agentMeta.desc: Artifact provenance written when an agent creates the node.

modelId.desc: Selected image model. Must be a modelId from list_canvas_models (type=image).

promptPreset.desc: Preset key. Only the key is stored; the full preset prompt lives server-side and is never exposed.

presetParams.desc: Per-dimension option keys for the selected preset.

pendingGen.desc: Input snapshot taken when generate was clicked.

modelId.desc: Selected video model. Must be a modelId from list_canvas_models (type=video).

videoPrompt.desc: Generation prompt. Note the field name differs from gen-image (browser storage name is authoritative).

scriptRowId.desc: Back-reference to the script node row this node was spawned for.

pendingGen.desc: Input snapshot taken when generate was clicked.

modelId.desc: Selected audio model. Must be a modelId from list_canvas_models (type=audio).

pendingGen.desc: Input snapshot taken when generate was clicked.

sourceGenAudioId.desc: Source gen node this audio came from.

text.desc: Body markdown. This is what downstream generation nodes read as fallback prompt.

genPrompt.desc: Instruction for AI-generating the body. Distinct from text (the body itself).

modelId.desc: Model used for AI body generation. Must be a modelId from list_canvas_models (type=text).

sourceGenImageId.desc: Which gen-image node produced this preview.

sourceGenVideoId.desc: Which gen-video node produced this preview.

sourceGenAudioId.desc: Which gen-audio node produced this preview.

autoFittedFor.desc: Which image URL the node box was already fitted to.

upstreamExpire.desc: RFC3339 deadline after which the upstream asset is no longer reachable. Determines whether the limited desubtitle option is available.

rows.desc: Shot table. Each row: {id?, name, duration, prompt, colorMark}. Send the WHOLE table, not a partial one.

scriptPrompt.desc: Instruction used when generating the shot table.

assets.desc: Character/scene/prop library. Read-only but VISIBLE on purpose: row prompts reference assets by name via @[kind-name] tokens, so writing rows correctly requires knowing what exists here.

globalStyle.desc: Global style string prefixed onto every row prompt.

durationSec.desc: Master cut duration. Upper bound for per-row duration; changing it would leave existing rows out of range.

directorProject.desc: Entire 3D director project document. Not a config field.
